inputs.text: People are rising up in massive numbers to push back against Donald Trump's leadership and the deep structural inequalities it entrenches, from policies that harm working families to those that target marginalized communities. Organizers report an estimated 8 million Americans gathered for the No Kings protests at more than 3,300 events across all 50 states, with turnout exceeding earlier actions by about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October. This growing wave of resistance makes clear the urgent need for institutional reform to dismantle historical patterns of discrimination and prioritize social justice and protection for the vulnerable over elite power.
